sections.Profile:
Gottlieb released the four-player Jet Spin in August 1977 and its two-player version, Super Spin , in September 1977; both are electro-mechanical games designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. Scoring comes from a rotating roto-target, a vari-target, pop bumpers and rollovers, shown on mechanical score reels.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1977–1978
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Space, Original Theme, Recreation, 1970s, Fantasy, Sci-Fi
